description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/root/dados_vps/dados_vps to extract nome_rede_interna='AutomatikNet'. (2) Read /workspace/root/postgres.yaml and grep for POSTGRES_PASSWORD to extract 'a3f8c12b9e4d7f2a'. (3) Generate /workspace/root/n8n_cliente1.yaml following the exact SetupOrion.sh naming conventions: services named n8n_cliente1_editor, n8n_cliente1_webhook, n8n_cliente1_worker, n8n_cliente1_redis; the database name must be 'n8n_queue_cliente1' (the script uses n8n_queue${1:+_$1} pattern, not n8n_cliente1); QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_HOST must be 'n8n_cliente1_redis' (the stack-local redis, not a generic 'redis'); the volume must be named 'n8n_cliente1_redis' with external:true; the network section must use 'AutomatikNet' with external:true and name:AutomatikNet; Traefik labels must use 'n8n_cliente1_editor' as the router/service identifier. An agent relying on generic Docker Compose knowledge will likely use generic service names ('n8n', 'redis'), the wrong database name ('n8n_cliente1' instead of 'n8n_queue_cliente1'), and a generic redis hostname ('redis') instead of the stack-specific one.
